translation: to take care of / to look after
logicalExplanation: Wrapping your attention 'around' a household task or person needing care.

sentences.german: Ich kümmere mich um den Garten.
sentences.english: I take care of the garden.

sentences.german: Wir kümmern uns um den Garten.
sentences.english: We take care of the garden.

sentences.german: Sie kümmert sich um den Garten.
sentences.english: She takes care of the garden.

logicalExplanation: Radiating joy that flows over an existing home comfort or gift.

sentences.german: Ich freue mich über das Geschenk.
sentences.english: I am happy about the gift.

sentences.german: Wir freuen uns über das Geschenk.
sentences.english: We are happy about the gift.

sentences.german: Sie freut sich über das Geschenk.
sentences.english: She is happy about the gift.

logicalExplanation: Guarding your time with eyes fixed on an arrival.

translation: to be annoyed about / to be vexed over
logicalExplanation: Letting frustration spill 'over' a household annoyance.

sentences.german: Ich ärgere mich über den Lärm.
sentences.english: I am annoyed about the noise.

sentences.german: Wir ärgern uns über den Lärm.
sentences.english: We are annoyed about the noise.

sentences.german: Sie ärgert sich über den Lärm.
sentences.english: She is annoyed about the noise.

translation: to think of / to remember to do
logicalExplanation: Directing a mental spotlight toward an errand or item.

sentences.english: I think of the shopping list.
We think of the shopping list.
She thinks of the shopping list.
